_readme: Proofs that cannot run in the test suite, and the hash of what they proved.
cockpit/tests/proof-staleness.test.ts fails while a recorded hash does not
match the file on disk. It does NOT run the SQL and cannot know whether you
really ran it -- it converts 'remember to run this' into 'the suite asks'.
A stale alarm is not a proof. It is the difference between a note and a control.
To re-bless after running the proof: npm run proof:bless

proofs.what: The views aggregate, group and join correctly. The RULES are proved separately and automatically in cockpit/tests/consent-resolution.test.ts.
proofs.how: Paste db/tests/0013_consent_view.test.sql into the Supabase SQL editor and run it. It rolls itself back. Expect two NOTICEs and no exception.

proofs.what: The three invariants of the send record and the authorisation freeze, each SEEN to refuse a row it must refuse. Two of the three are check constraints rather than observations, which is only possible because the row precedes the send.
proofs.how: Paste db/tests/0015_sends_constraints.test.sql into the Supabase SQL editor and run it. It rolls itself back. Expect 'ALL SIX CONSTRAINT CASES FIRED', the neighbour accepted, and three freeze notices. Any 'DID NOT FIRE' is a constraint that is not holding.

proofs.what: The freeze inverted from a denylist to an allowlist: outcome columns writable, every other column frozen INCLUDING ones 0015 never mentioned. 0015's version would have allowed campaign_id to be edited after the fact.
proofs.how: Paste db/migrations/0017_sends_attempts_and_allowlist_freeze.sql, then run its verify block inside begin/rollback. Expect: attempts/last_attempt_at/last_error writable; gate_decided_at refused BY NAME; campaign_id refused (0015 would have allowed it).

proofs.what: A halted run must say why, and an evaluated run's counts must add up: target = excluded + permitted + refused. A shape that does not add up is not a record.
proofs.how: Paste db/migrations/0018_campaign_runs.sql, then its verify block inside begin/rollback. Expect halted_states_its_reason to refuse a halt with no reason; forecast_adds_up to refuse 23+20+200 against a target of 300 and to ACCEPT 23+20+257.
